title: Effective module descent from coherent transitions on a locally directed open cover
statement: Let X be a scheme and let U be a universe-small open cover whose indices form a thin category and whose transition maps make it locally directed (as in Mathlib Scheme.Cover.LocallyDirected). For each index i let M_i be a sheaf of modules on U_i. For each arrow f:i→j give an isomorphism t_f:f^*M_j≅M_i for the section-normalized tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]. Suppose t_(f≫g) equals the composite of the equality transport along trans_comp, the normalized pullback composition isomorphism, the pullback of t_g and t_f. Then there exist a sheaf of modules L on X and charts c_i:(U_i→X)^*L≅M_i such that every arrow f:i→j gives c_i by composing the equality transport along trans_map, normalized pullback composition, the pullback of c_j and t_f. This assumes no grading, Proj structure, quasi-coherence or finiteness.

source.place: Tag 01LI, lemma-relative-glueing-sheaves, proof: common refinements and overlap cocycle; general sheaves of modules version using Sheaves Tags 04TN, 00AL, 00AM.

proof.text: Construct L as the explicit multiequalizer tensorMatchingModule of the pushed-forward local modules. Its projections have canonical normalized adjoint chart maps and satisfy the full chart equation by the proved mate and multiequalizer compatibility lemmas.
The tensor cocycle and local directedness make every canonical matching chart map invertible, by lem-trf-directed-tensor-matching-chart-is-iso. Regard each map as its associated isomorphism.

Use tensorMatchingModule and the canonical tensorMatchingChartIso as the existential witnesses. Their exact required equation is tensorMatchingChartIso_condition, proved by the abstract isomorphism-factor comparison and the normalized mate/multiequalizer calculation. No new existence assertion is used.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_directed_tensor_module_descent
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (𝒰 : X.OpenCover.{u}) [Category.{v} 𝒰.I₀]
    [𝒰.LocallyDirected] [Quiver.IsThin 𝒰.I₀]
    (M : ∀ i : 𝒰.I₀, (𝒰.X i).Modules)
    (t : ∀ {i j : 𝒰.I₀} (f : i ⟶ j), (tensorPullback (𝒰.trans f)).obj (M j) ≅ M i)
    (ht : ∀ {i j k : 𝒰.I₀} (f : i ⟶ j) (g : j ⟶ k),
      t (f ≫ g) =
        eqToIso (congrArg (fun a ↦ (tensorPullback a).obj (M k)) (𝒰.trans_comp f g)) ≪≫
          (tensorPullbackSectionComp (𝒰.trans f) (𝒰.trans g)).app (M k) ≪≫
          (tensorPullback (𝒰.trans f)).mapIso (t g) ≪≫ t f) :
    ∃ (L : X.Modules) (chart : ∀ i : 𝒰.I₀, (tensorPullback (𝒰.f i)).obj L ≅ M i),
      ∀ {i j : 𝒰.I₀} (f : i ⟶ j),
        eqToIso (congrArg (fun a ↦ (tensorPullback a).obj L) (𝒰.trans_map f).symm) ≪≫
          (tensorPullbackSectionComp (𝒰.trans f) (𝒰.f j)).app L ≪≫
          (tensorPullback (𝒰.trans f)).mapIso (chart j) ≪≫ t f = chart i
